school.tagged_body:
The Best Pass

Dohun was the best basketball player on his school team. Last {{v:season}}, he {{v:scored}} more than {{v:half}} of the team's {{v:points}}. {{g:Every time he got the ball|every time + 주어 + 동사: ~할 때마다}}, he tried to shoot. He shot {{g:even when|even when + 주어 + 동사: ~할 때조차도}} three players were {{v:guarding}} him.

But the team {{g:kept losing|keep + -ing: 계속 ~하다}}. In the {{v:semifinal}} game, Dohun {{v:missed}} {{g:shot after shot|명사 + after + 명사: 연이은 ~ (계속해서)}}. The team {{g:lost by ten points|by + 차이: ~만큼 (점수 차이)}}. After the game, {{v:Coach}} Kim sat down {{v:next to}} him.

"Dohun, you are a great player," she said. "But {{t:basketball is not a one-person game}}. When you have the ball, {{g:look around|명령문: 동사원형으로 시작 (~해라)}}. Your {{v:teammates}} are {{v:open}}."

For the next month, Dohun {{v:practiced}} passing very hard. He practiced it {{g:as hard as|as + 원급 + as: ~만큼 …하게}} shooting. {{v:At first}}, it felt {{v:strange}}. But slowly, he {{g:began to trust|begin + to부정사: ~하기 시작하다}} his teammates, and they began to {{v:trust}} him, too.

In the final game of the season, the team was {{v:behind}} by two points. There were only five seconds {{v:left}}. Dohun got the ball. Everyone thought, "He will shoot." But he saw Jaewon. Jaewon {{g:was standing|과거진행형: was + -ing (~하고 있었다)}} {{v:alone}} at the three-point line. Dohun passed the ball to him. Jaewon shot, and the ball went in {{g:just as|just as + 주어 + 동사: 바로 ~할 때}} the {{v:whistle}} blew.

The team jumped into the air together. Dohun did not score the {{v:winning}} shot, but he {{g:did not care anymore|not ~ anymore: 더 이상 ~하지 않다}}. {{t:It was the best pass of his life}}.

questions.q: What is the story mainly about?
choices: A boy who wants to become a coach
A star player who learns to trust his teammates
A team that never loses a game
A player who stops playing basketball
A coach who scores the winning shot
questions.answer: A star player who learns to trust his teammates
questions.explanation: 혼자 슛만 하던 도훈이 팀 동료를 믿게 되는 이야기이다.

questions.q: What did Dohun do every time he got the ball?
choices: He passed it to Jaewon.
He gave it to the coach.
He looked around first.
He tried to shoot.
He stopped and waited.
questions.answer: He tried to shoot.
questions.explanation: 'Every time he got the ball, he tried to shoot.'

questions.q: How many of the team's points did Dohun score last season?
choices: More than half
Less than half
Only ten points
None of them
Exactly two points
questions.answer: More than half
questions.explanation: 'he scored more than half of the team's points.'

questions.q: What happened in the semifinal game?
choices: The team won by ten points.
Dohun scored the winning shot.
Jaewon got hurt.
The game was stopped.
The team lost by ten points.
questions.answer: The team lost by ten points.
questions.explanation: 'The team lost by ten points.'

questions.q: Who sat down next to Dohun after the game?
choices: Jaewon
Dohun's mother
Coach Kim
Three players
The other team's coach
questions.answer: Coach Kim
questions.explanation: 'After the game, Coach Kim sat down next to him.'

questions.q: What did Coach Kim mean by "basketball is not a one-person game"?
choices: Only one player should shoot.
Players should play together as a team.
Basketball is an easy game.
Dohun should stop playing.
Five players are too many.
questions.answer: Players should play together as a team.
questions.explanation: 농구는 혼자 하는 경기가 아니다 → 팀으로 함께 해야 한다.

questions.q: What did Coach Kim tell Dohun to do when he has the ball?
choices: Shoot right away
Run to the coach
Close his eyes
Throw it out
Look around
questions.answer: Look around
questions.explanation: 'When you have the ball, look around.'

questions.q: What did Dohun practice hard for the next month?
choices: Passing
Only shooting
Running
Jumping
Swimming
questions.answer: Passing
questions.explanation: 'Dohun practiced passing very hard.'

questions.q: How did passing feel to Dohun at first?
choices: Easy
Exciting
Perfect
Strange
Funny
questions.answer: Strange
questions.explanation: 'At first, it felt strange.'

questions.q: What happened slowly?
choices: Dohun stopped practicing.
Coach Kim left the team.
Dohun and his teammates began to trust each other.
The team stopped playing.
Dohun began to shoot more.
questions.answer: Dohun and his teammates began to trust each other.
questions.explanation: 'he began to trust his teammates, and they began to trust him, too.'

questions.q: In the final game, how many seconds were left?
choices: Five
Two
Ten
Three
Fifteen
questions.answer: Five
questions.explanation: 'There were only five seconds left.' (2는 뒤진 점수, 10은 준결승 점수 차, 3은 3점 라인)

questions.q: What did everyone think Dohun would do?
choices: Pass to Jaewon
Call the coach
Stop the game
Leave the court
Shoot the ball
questions.answer: Shoot the ball
questions.explanation: Everyone thought, "He will shoot."

questions.q: Where was Jaewon standing?
choices: Next to Coach Kim
Alone at the three-point line
Behind three players
Outside the gym
Next to Dohun
questions.answer: Alone at the three-point line
questions.explanation: 'Jaewon was standing alone at the three-point line.'

questions.q: What happened just as the whistle blew?
choices: Dohun's shot went in.
Jaewon missed the shot.
The ball went out.
Jaewon's shot went in.
The other team scored.
questions.answer: Jaewon's shot went in.
questions.explanation: 'Jaewon shot, and the ball went in just as the whistle blew.'

questions.q: How did Dohun feel at the end of the story?
choices: Angry because he did not score
Sad because the team lost
Happy, even though he did not score
Jealous of Jaewon
Tired and bored
questions.answer: Happy, even though he did not score
questions.explanation: 그는 결승골을 넣지 않았지만 더 이상 신경 쓰지 않았다 → 기뻤다.

questions.q: Why was it "the best pass of his life"?
choices: It was the longest pass in the game.
He scored three points with it.
Coach Kim made the pass for him.
It was the first pass of his life.
It helped his team win, and it showed his trust in his teammates.
questions.answer: It helped his team win, and it showed his trust in his teammates.
questions.explanation: 팀이 이기게 했고, 동료를 믿는 마음을 보여 준 패스이기 때문이다.

questions.q: Which is NOT true about the story?
choices: Dohun scored the winning shot.
Dohun was the best player on his team.
The team kept losing.
Coach Kim talked to Dohun.
Jaewon was standing alone.
questions.answer: Dohun scored the winning shot.
questions.explanation: 결승골은 재원이가 넣었다. 도훈은 패스를 했다.

questions.q: Which sentence is correct, like "The team kept losing"?
choices: She kept talk during the movie.
She kept to talk during the movie.
She kept talking during the movie.
She kept talked during the movie.
She keep talking during the movie.
questions.answer: She kept talking during the movie.
questions.explanation: keep + -ing: 계속 ~하다. 과거이므로 kept.

Dohun passed to Jaewon, and the team won.
Dohun tried to shoot every time he got the ball.

The team lost the semifinal game by ten points.
answer: Dohun tried to shoot every time he got the ball.
The team lost the semifinal game by ten points.
Coach Kim told Dohun to look around.
Dohun practiced passing for a month.
Dohun passed to Jaewon, and the team won.

essays.rubric: ① 재원이가 혼자(비어) 있음 ② 동료를 믿게 됨 또는 코치의 조언

essays.q: 다음 우리말을 영어로 쓰시오. '도훈은 슛만큼 열심히 패스를 연습했다.' <조건> as ~ as를 사용할 것

questions.q: What is the lesson of the story?
choices: You should practice shooting more than passing.
Teamwork can be more valuable than one player's success.
Winning is the only important thing in sports.
Great players never need a coach.
Losing a game is always the coach's fault.
questions.answer: Teamwork can be more valuable than one player's success.
questions.explanation: 혼자 득점하는 것보다 팀 동료를 믿는 것이 더 값지다는 교훈이다.

questions.q: Why did the team keep losing?
choices: The other players were hurt.
Coach Kim did not come to the games.
Dohun did not practice shooting.
Dohun tried to do everything by himself.
The team had too many players.
questions.answer: Dohun tried to do everything by himself.
questions.explanation: 세 명이 막고 있어도 혼자 슛을 하려 했고, 비어 있는 동료를 활용하지 않았다.

questions.q: What does 'even when three players were guarding him' show about Dohun?
choices: He tried to shoot even in very difficult situations.
He was afraid of the other players.
Three of his teammates helped him.
He always passed when he was guarded.
He was a bad shooter.
questions.answer: He tried to shoot even in very difficult situations.
questions.explanation: 세 명이 수비할 때조차 슛을 했다 → 무리하게 혼자 하려 했다.

questions.q: What does 'Dohun missed shot after shot' mean?
choices: He made every shot.
He missed only one shot.
He shot after the game.
He passed after each shot.
He missed many shots, one after another.
questions.answer: He missed many shots, one after another.
questions.explanation: shot after shot = 연이은 슛 → 계속해서 슛을 놓쳤다.

questions.q: In 'Your teammates are open,' 'open' means ____.
choices: not closed
not busy
not guarded by any player
honest
not tired
questions.answer: not guarded by any player
questions.explanation: 농구에서 open = 수비가 붙지 않아 비어 있는.

questions.q: How did Coach Kim talk to Dohun after the game?
choices: She shouted at him angrily.
She praised him first and then gave him advice.
She did not say anything to him.
She told him to leave the team.
She blamed his teammates.
questions.answer: She praised him first and then gave him advice.
questions.explanation: 'you are a great player'로 먼저 칭찬하고 '농구는 혼자 하는 경기가 아니다'라고 조언했다.

questions.q: How hard did Dohun practice passing?
choices: Less hard than he had practiced shooting
Only once a week
Not hard at all
Only on the day of the final game
As hard as he had practiced shooting
questions.answer: As hard as he had practiced shooting
questions.explanation: 'Dohun practiced passing as hard as he had practiced shooting.'

questions.q: Which best describes how Dohun changed?
choices: From a player who only shot to a player who trusted his teammates
From a good passer to a good shooter
From a coach to a player
From a team player to a selfish player
From a bad player to the best player
questions.answer: From a player who only shot to a player who trusted his teammates
questions.explanation: 혼자 슛만 하던 선수 → 동료를 믿는 선수.

questions.q: What was the situation near the end of the final game?
choices: The team was ten points ahead.
The score was tied.
The team was two points ahead.
The team was two points behind with five seconds left.
The team was five points behind.
questions.answer: The team was two points behind with five seconds left.
questions.explanation: 'the team was behind by two points with only five seconds left.'

questions.q: Why did everyone expect Dohun to shoot?
choices: Because Jaewon told everyone to watch him
Because Coach Kim shouted at him to shoot
Because he had always tried to shoot when he got the ball
Because he was the tallest player
Because he never shot the ball
questions.answer: Because he had always tried to shoot when he got the ball
questions.explanation: 예전에는 공만 잡으면 슛을 했기 때문에 모두 그가 슛할 거라고 예상했다.

questions.q: What does the word 'Instead' show in the fifth paragraph?
choices: Dohun did something different from what people expected.
Dohun shot the ball as people expected.
Dohun gave up the game.
Coach Kim stopped the game.
Jaewon passed the ball to Dohun.
questions.answer: Dohun did something different from what people expected.
questions.explanation: Instead = 그 대신에 → 기대(슛)와 다르게 패스를 했다.

questions.q: Why did Dohun pass the ball to Jaewon?
choices: Jaewon asked for the ball loudly.
Dohun was hurt and could not shoot.
Coach Kim told him to pass to Jaewon.
Jaewon was guarded by three players.
Jaewon was standing alone at the three-point line.
questions.answer: Jaewon was standing alone at the three-point line.
questions.explanation: 'he saw Jaewon, who was standing alone at the three-point line, and passed.'

questions.q: What does 'the ball went in just as the whistle blew' mean?
choices: The ball went in after the game ended.
The ball went in at the very moment the game ended.
The ball went in before Jaewon shot.
The ball missed the basket.
The whistle blew two times.
questions.answer: The ball went in at the very moment the game ended.
questions.explanation: just as = 바로 ~할 때 → 경기 종료 휘슬과 동시에 들어갔다.

questions.q: What does 'he no longer cared' mean?
choices: He did not care about his team.
He wanted to quit basketball.
He was angry at Jaewon.
Scoring the winning shot was not important to him anymore.
He cared more about scoring than before.
questions.answer: Scoring the winning shot was not important to him anymore.
questions.explanation: no longer = 더 이상 ~않다 → 자신이 결승골을 넣지 않은 것은 이제 상관없었다.

questions.q: Which uses the past perfect correctly, like 'he had scored more than half of the team's points'?
choices: When I had arrived, the movie already starts.
When I arrive, the movie had started.
When I arrived, the movie had already started.
When I arrived, the movie has already started.
When I arrived, the movie had already start.
questions.answer: When I arrived, the movie had already started.
questions.explanation: 과거(arrived)보다 더 이전에 일어난 일 → had + p.p.(had started).

questions.q: Which sentence is correct, like 'everyone expected him to shoot'?
choices: My parents expected me win the game.
My parents expected me winning the game.
My parents expected I to win the game.
My parents expected me to won the game.
My parents expected me to win the game.
questions.answer: My parents expected me to win the game.
questions.explanation: expect + 목적어(me) + to + 동사원형(win).

questions.q: Which sentence is correct, like 'he saw Jaewon, who was standing alone'?
choices: I met Mina, who lives next door.
I met Mina, which lives next door.
I met Mina, that lives next door.
I met Mina, who live next door.
I met Mina, whom lives next door.
questions.answer: I met Mina, who lives next door.
questions.explanation: 계속적 용법: 사람 → , who (that은 콤마 뒤에 쓸 수 없다). Mina는 단수 → lives.

questions.q: Which is NOT true according to the story?
choices: Dohun had scored more than half of the team's points.
The team lost the semifinal by ten points.
Coach Kim told Dohun to shoot more often.
Passing felt strange to Dohun at first.
Jaewon shot the ball as the whistle blew.
questions.answer: Coach Kim told Dohun to shoot more often.
questions.explanation: 코치는 슛을 더 하라는 것이 아니라 주위를 둘러보라고(패스하라고) 했다.

items: Dohun and his teammates began to trust each other.
Dohun missed shot after shot, and the team lost the semifinal.
Dohun passed to Jaewon, and the ball went in.
Dohun practiced passing for the next month.
Coach Kim told Dohun that basketball is not a one-person game.
answer: Dohun missed shot after shot, and the team lost the semifinal.
Coach Kim told Dohun that basketball is not a one-person game.
Dohun practiced passing for the next month.
Dohun and his teammates began to trust each other.
Dohun passed to Jaewon, and the ball went in.

essays.q: Summarize the story in two English sentences: (1) Dohun's problem and (2) how he changed.
essays.sampleAnswer: Dohun was the best player on his team, but he always tried to shoot by himself, so the team kept losing. After his coach's advice, he learned to trust his teammates and made the pass that won the final game.
essays.rubric: ① 문제(혼자 슛) ② 변화(동료 신뢰) ③ 결과(결승 패스) ④ 영어 2문장

essays.q: 우리말로 쓰시오: 김 코치의 말 "basketball is not a one-person game"의 의미를 쓰고, 이 말을 들은 뒤 도훈이 어떻게 변했는지 쓰시오.
essays.sampleAnswer: 농구는 혼자 하는 경기가 아니라 팀이 함께 하는 경기라는 뜻이다. 이 말을 들은 뒤 도훈은 한 달 동안 슛을 연습했던 만큼 열심히 패스를 연습했고, 점차 동료를 믿게 되어 마지막 경기에서 비어 있는 재원이에게 패스했다.
essays.rubric: ① 말의 의미(팀 경기) ② 패스 연습 ③ 동료를 믿게 됨 / 결승 패스

essays.q: Why was it 'the best pass of Dohun's life'? Answer in English.
essays.sampleAnswer: Because it helped his team win the final game, and it showed that he trusted his teammates.
essays.rubric: ① 팀의 승리 ② 동료에 대한 신뢰 ③ 완전한 영어 문장

essays.q: 다음 우리말을 영어로 쓰시오. '모두가 그가 슛을 할 거라고 기대했다.' <조건> expect + 목적어 + to부정사, 과거시제

The Best Pass

Dohun was, {{v:without question}}, the most {{v:talented}} basketball player on his school team. Last season, he {{g:had scored|과거완료: had + p.p. (과거보다 더 이전의 일)}} more than half of the team's points {{v:on his own}}. {{g:Whenever the ball came to him|복합관계부사 whenever: ~할 때마다}}, he {{v:attempted}} a shot, even when he {{g:was surrounded by|수동태: be + p.p. + by (~에게 둘러싸이다)}} three {{v:defenders}}.

{{v:Nevertheless}}, the team kept losing. In the semifinal, Dohun missed {{g:one shot after another|one ~ after another: 잇따라, 연달아}}, and the team {{g:was defeated by ten points|수동태 + by 차이: 10점 차로 패배했다}}. After the game, Coach Kim sat down {{v:beside}} him.

"Dohun, you are a {{v:remarkable}} player," she said. "But {{t:basketball is not a one-person game}}. Whenever you have the ball, look around. Your teammates {{g:are often left|5형식 수동태: be left + 형용사 (~한 상태로 남겨지다)}} {{v:wide open}}."

For the following month, Dohun practiced passing {{g:as intensely as he had once practiced shooting|as + 원급 + as: 예전에 슛을 연습했던 만큼 강도 높게}}. At first, it felt {{v:unnatural}} to him. {{v:Gradually}}, however, he learned to {{v:rely on}} his teammates, and they, {{v:in turn}}, {{g:came to trust|come to + 동사원형: (점차) ~하게 되다}} him.

In the final game of the season, the team was {{v:trailing}} by two points {{g:with only five seconds remaining|with + 명사 + 현재분사: ~가 …하는 채로}}. When Dohun received the ball, {{g:everyone assumed that he would take the shot|시제 일치: 주절이 과거(assumed) → that절 will도 would}}. Instead, he {{v:spotted}} Jaewon, {{g:who was standing|계속적 용법 주격 관계대명사 who}} {{v:unguarded}} at the three-point line, and passed. Jaewon shot, and the ball dropped through the net just as the final whistle blew.

The whole team {{v:leapt}} into the air together. {{g:Although Dohun had not scored|양보 접속사 although + 과거완료 부정(had not p.p.)}} the winning basket, it no longer {{v:mattered}} to him. {{t:It was the best pass he had ever made}}.

questions.q: Which 'would' expresses a past habit, as in 'he would attempt a shot'?
choices: I would like a glass of water, please.
He said that he would come to the party.
When I was young, I would visit my grandmother every summer.
If I were you, I would apologize to her.
Would you open the window for me?
questions.answer: When I was young, I would visit my grandmother every summer.
questions.explanation: 과거의 습관 would = ~하곤 했다.

questions.q: Which uses the to-infinitive in the same way as 'the one to score the decisive basket'?
choices: She wanted to finish the test early.
She went to the library to study.
It is hard to finish the test in an hour.
She decided to finish the test first.
She was the first student to finish the test.
questions.answer: She was the first student to finish the test.
questions.explanation: to부정사의 형용사적 용법: 앞의 명사(the one / the first student)를 꾸민다.

questions.q: Which sentence is correct, like 'Dohun devoted himself to passing'?
choices: He devoted himself to helping poor children.
He devoted himself to help poor children.
He devoted him to helping poor children.
He devoted himself helping poor children.
He devoted to himself helping poor children.
questions.answer: He devoted himself to helping poor children.
questions.explanation: devote oneself to + 동명사: to는 전치사이므로 -ing. 주어와 같은 대상 → 재귀대명사 himself.

essays.q: Summarize the story in three English sentences: (1) Dohun's flaw, (2) the turning point, and (3) the significance of the ending.
essays.sampleAnswer: Although Dohun was the most gifted player on his team, he insisted on shooting whenever he had the ball, and the team continued to suffer defeats. After the semifinal, Coach Kim reminded him that basketball is not a one-person game, so he devoted himself to passing and began to trust his teammates. In the final seconds of the championship, he passed to an open Jaewon instead of shooting, which showed that team victory now mattered more to him than personal glory.
essays.rubric: ① 결점 ② 전환점 ③ 결말의 의미 ④ 영어 3문장, 정확성

essays.q: 우리말로 쓰시오: 김 코치가 도훈에게 조언한 방식(칭찬 → 조언)을 설명하고, 이 방식이 도훈에게 어떤 효과가 있었는지 지문에 근거해 쓰시오.
essays.sampleAnswer: 김 코치는 먼저 "넌 특출한 선수다"라고 도훈의 재능을 인정한 뒤, "농구는 혼자 하는 경기가 아니다, 코트를 둘러봐라"라고 조언했다. 비난하지 않고 인정해 주었기 때문에 도훈은 조언을 받아들여 한 달 동안 끈질기게 패스를 연습했고, 결국 동료를 믿게 되어 결승전에서 결정적인 패스를 했다.
essays.rubric: ① 칭찬 후 조언이라는 방식 ② 패스 연습·신뢰라는 효과 ③ 지문 근거

essays.q: 다음 우리말을 영어로 쓰시오. '도훈은 패스 연습에 전념했다.' <조건> devote oneself to를 사용할 것
essays.sampleAnswer: Dohun devoted himself to practicing passing.
essays.rubric: ① devoted himself ② to + 동명사(practicing) ③ passing

essays.q: 다음 문장을 expect + 목적어 + to부정사를 사용하여 같은 뜻으로 바꿔 쓰시오. 'When Dohun received the ball, everyone anticipated that he would take the final shot.'
essays.sampleAnswer: When Dohun received the ball, everyone expected him to take the final shot.
essays.rubric: ① everyone expected ② him ③ to take the final shot ④ 나머지 내용 유지

essays.q: Which is more important for a team: one exceptional player or players who trust one another? Give your opinion with a reason or example in 3–4 English sentences.
essays.sampleAnswer: I think players who trust one another are more important. Even an exceptional player cannot win alone when the opponents guard him closely, as Dohun's story shows. When players trust each other, they can find the open player and make better decisions. That is why a team with trust usually beats a team that depends on one star.
essays.rubric: ① 입장 ② 이유 또는 예시(지문 활용 가능) ③ 영어 3~4문장, 정확성
